g.desc: Each point represents one viral proteome; the highlighted point is the selected proteome. The X-axis shows the total length of its protein sequences. The Y-axis shows human protein reach: the percentage of eligible human targets matched at least once by any protein in that proteome at the indicated core identity threshold. The denominator includes 20,333 human records of at least 50 residues (11,412,569 residues in total). Each threshold panel has its own Y-axis range.
